notes: German site. Discovery via direct HTTP fetch (tier 1): robots.txt (https://www.westwing.de/robots.txt) checked first - a group naming ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai disallows only /c/*, /collections/*, /products/*, /all-products, /api/* (no blanket 'Disallow: /'), and none of westwing.de's category URLs use those path patterns (all flat top-level slugs, e.g. /weihnachtsdeko/), so this is not a policy opt-out and tier-1 HTTP access was used throughout, no browser automation needed. Enumerated sitemap-categories.xml, sitemap-filtered-categories.xml and sitemap-common-pages.xml (full text search for weihnacht/advent/halloween/ostern/silvester/valentin/diwali/muttertag/vatertag/karneval/erntedank etc.) - only a Christmas/Advent branch exists; no Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, New Year, or other holiday categories exist anywhere in the site's taxonomy. sitemap-filtered-categories.xml entries under these slugs are colour/material facet variants of the same base categories (e.g. /weihnachten/_rot/, /weihnachten/~glas/) and were excluded as filter pages, not distinct categories. Homepage nav is client-rendered (no static links in SSR HTML) so the sitemap + the /weihnachten/ hub page's own outbound links were used as the discovery path instead. /weihnachten/ (139 products via '120 von 139 Produkten werden angezeigt') is a real combined PLP that also links out to the 12 included subcategories below (subset children, heavy facet overlap so the 139 is not a strict sum) - kept as a top-level grouping row per the parent/child rule, qty nulled to avoid double-counting. Checked and dropped (verified genuine 0-product '0 von 0 Produkten' via HTTP, current stock-out / off-season, not proof of absence of the branch itself): weihnachtsbeleuchtung (Christmas Lighting), kuenstliche-weihnachtsbaeume (Christmas Trees), weihnachtsbaumschmuck (Christmas Tree Ornaments), weihnachtskugeln (Christmas Baubles), weihnachtsbaumspitzen (Christmas Tree Toppers), advent-wreaths (Advent Wreaths, English-language slug title). Excluded as non-genuine/ambiguous: weihnachtswelten (H1 'Weihnachts-Styles', 0 products, reads as an inspiration/style hub, not a PLP); weihnachtskraenze (H1 and meta description are the generic 'Kranze & Girlanden' with no Christmas wording anywhere on-page beyond the URL slug, and also 0 products). weihnachtsfiguren and weihnachtskerzen have generic on-page H1s ('Dekoobjekte' / 'Kerzen & Kerzenhalter') but their meta description explicitly and repeatedly names Weihnachten/Weihnachtsfiguren/Adventskerzen, so they were kept as genuine Christmas-associated categories per the site's own SEO/meta framing. Per seasonal rules §7, Christmas textile/tableware/storage rows below are kept even though they'd normally be excluded from other decor categories.
